# Security Requirements Checklist: Google OAuth Login

## Authentication Security Requirements

- [x] CHK003 - Is HTTPS-only transmission requirement quantified with specific protocol versions? [Clarity, Spec §SR-003]
- [x] CHK004 - Are Google OAuth scope requirements explicitly documented with justification? [Completeness, Spec §SR-004]
- [x] CHK005 - Is token refresh mechanism security specified with failure handling? [Completeness, Spec §SR-005]
- [x] CHK006 - Are authentication failure rate limiting requirements defined? [Completeness, Spec §SR-006]
